desc: Sort intervals by end point and create a mapping to original indices for later reconstruction.
Implement DP where dp[k][i] is the max weight using k intervals from the first i sorted intervals, using binary search to find the best previous non-overlapping interval.
Compute the maximum possible score for up to 4 intervals.
Reconstruct the lexicographically smallest set of indices by iterating through original indices and checking feasibility using precomputed DP values.
Return the reconstructed list of indices.
